title: Opening and birth, family without musicians
summary: Interview intro with address and date (1961); Jackson was born uptown in 1909 and is the only musician in his family.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: It's teaching school. It's going okay. I'll make a note that we're interviewing Mr. Henry Jackson, and the address is 3505 Magnolia. And let's see, this is August the 9th, isn't it? August the 9th. 1961. Right. Do you mind giving me your full name? Have any middle name? Henry Jackson. And can you tell us just what part of town you came from? Were you born right here in town?
I was born right here in New Orleans in uptown section.

This is what you call the garden district of New Orleans. What is your birth date? I was born in New England the 24th, 1909. And did any of your folks play music? No. Did your father or mother play any instrument or sing? No, just me.
I'm the only musician in my family.
No uncles or brothers? Anybody else that played any music? No, I'm the only one playing. Do you remember some of the earliest music you ever heard when you were a boy in the bands?
